WITH all_customers_with_gender AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    COALESCE(gender, 'Unknown') as gender
  FROM Customers
),
customer_invoice_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    acwg.customer_id,
    acwg.gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.invoice_number IS NOT NULL THEN i.invoice_number END) as num_invoiced_orders
  FROM all_customers_with_gender acwg
  LEFT JOIN Orders o ON acwg.customer_id = o.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  GROUP BY acwg.customer_id, acwg.gender
),
gender_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    gender,
    AVG(num_invoiced_orders) as avg_invoiced_orders
  FROM customer_invoice_counts
  GROUP BY gender
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_invoiced_orders) as overall_avg
  FROM gender_averages
)
SELECT 
  ga.gender,
  ga.avg_invoiced_orders,
  ga.avg_invoiced_orders - oa.overall_avg as excess_over_average
FROM gender_averages ga
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE ga.avg_invoiced_orders > oa.overall_avg
ORDER BY ga.gender
